title: Root AGENTS.md makes the Development Verification Harness the mandatory completion contract for agents
description: Adds repository-root AGENTS.md: every code/config change must record its BASE SHA, update the current .pair-verification/patch-claim.json inside the BASE..HEAD diff, run npm run verify:change -- --base <BASE_SHA>, and fix until READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT before reporting complete; NOT_READY forbids completion claims; no self-merge without explicit operator instruction after independent audit. Failure contract and stale-claim prohibition documented. Proof: src/__tests__/dev-workflow-policy.test.ts asserts the contract text exists at the repo root. Docs-only/dev-infra change — no production PAIR runtime behavior altered.
